checks: Checklist approved before battery sample access Taiwanese Mandarin, distractor explanations and actual spoken context/number/question reviewed.

activeQuestion.prompt: What must happen before battery-powered samples enter the lab?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 電池供電樣品進入實驗室前，必須先完成什麼？

options.text: Their safety checklist must be approved.
options.zh: 安全檢查表必須獲核准。
options.whyZh: not ... until 明確表示核准是進場的必要前提；單有設備預約不夠。
公告要求安全檢查表，不是丟棄電池。

options.text: The samples must be sold to a customer.
The laboratory must close for the day.
options.zh: 實驗室必須先結束當日營業。
options.whyZh: 沒有要求閉館後才送樣。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: not ... until 明確表示核准是進場的必要前提；單有設備預約不夠。
activeQuestion.evidence: Do not bring battery-powered samples into the lab until their safety checklist has been approved.

vocabulary.note: 逐項確認樣品或操作符合安全條件的文件。

group.title: Booking reliability tests
group.passage: This announcement is for staff using the reliability laboratory. We have added a second vibration test machine, but all tests still require a booking. When submitting a request, include the product weight and the fixture drawing so the laboratory engineer can check whether the setup is safe. Bookings without these details will be returned. Do not bring battery-powered samples into the lab until their safety checklist has been approved. The new machine will be demonstrated on Wednesday at three. Attendance at that demonstration does not replace the separate operator training required before independent use.
group.passageZh: 這份公告給使用可靠度實驗室的同仁。我們新增了第二台振動測試機，但所有測試仍須預約。提交申請時，請附產品重量與治具圖面，讓實驗室工程師確認配置是否安全。缺少這些資訊的預約會被退回。電池供電樣品的安全檢查表核准之前，不得將其帶進實驗室。新機器將在星期三三點進行示範。參加這場示範不能取代獨立操作前必須完成的操作員訓練。
